title: Law to require pet clinics to post prices
summary: This bill would require veterinary care facilities to display standard prices or price ranges for common services and fees, and to give written estimates on request before charges exceeding $500. It would also require itemized receipts and require the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection to publish aggregated average prices for common procedures on a public website, updated quarterly. Violations would carry civil penalties up to $1,500 per violation.
